openai.reasoning: Respondent repeatedly commits to pressing BLUE and frames it as aligning with majority/cooperation, without identifying the dominance logic that red is individually safe regardless of others; they also do not clearly correct any mechanics.

gemini.reasoning: The respondent engages in a philosophical and sociological analysis of the dilemma, consistently framing the choice as a collective vs. individual values conflict. They avoid making a personal commitment to either button, instead discussing the motivations of hypothetical actors (Person X and Person Y) and societal trends. Because they never commit to a personal choice, they are classified as performatively hedged. They do not demonstrate an understanding of the dominant strategy (red) and fail to identify it, instead treating the dilemma as a coordination problem.
